scope: Existing frozen numeric-duration candidates and completed supplemental Pro judgments only; separate additive enhancement to old coarse production. No new review, model, labels, parser, sample or statistics.

status_specific.resolved: Nonempty relations list. Each relation has object in general_work/industry_domain/occupation_task/tool_specific and nonempty evidence list of {start,end,quote}; at least one evidence span contains this candidate numeric mention. Optional row-level evidence is checked if present.
status_specific.explicit_non_experience: relations=[]; nonblank reason; nonempty row evidence list with at least one span containing this candidate numeric mention.
status_specific.unknown: relations=[]; nonblank unknown_reason; optional row evidence list.

binding_rules: Verify all pinned file SHA256 values before reading and require exactly 2736 unique ledger candidate_id values; join ledger to original candidates and immutable packet map one-to-one on candidate_id while checking context_sha256 and split equality.

Candidate ID is SHA256 UTF-8 of context_sha256 + "|" + decimal entity_start + "|" + decimal entity_end. Offsets are zero-based Python Unicode character indices, half-open. Verify complete_context SHA256 UTF-8 equals context_sha256 and complete_context[entity_start:entity_end] equals original term.

Every {start,end,quote} evidence object must be an exact substring of the same complete_context; resolved relation evidence and explicit_non_experience evidence must contain the original numeric mention. Preserve relation object and exact evidence per candidate. Do not transfer evidence from a different mention or context.

Use context_sha256=normalized_context_sha256 only as a complete-normalized-context join to existing advertisement rows. Multiple ads can share one context. Keep each ad original identity, labels, masks and unknowns unchanged; no ad-level status is derived by taking one candidate status.

The accepted original-item tuple (context_sha256, source_sha256, source_record_id, original_item_path) belongs to recovered original-item supervision; the supplemental review ledger is bound to frozen numeric candidate_id and does not itself assert an original-item ID. Do not fabricate that link.

status_semantics.resolved: Pro-reviewed candidate-specific applicant-experience object relation(s), possibly multiple, supported by exact evidence. It does not alone establish a required/preferred amount, full same-item chain, or model-quality qualification.
status_semantics.explicit_non_experience: Pro-reviewed judgment that this particular frozen numeric duration does not constrain applicant experience, with exact evidence and reason. It can reject this candidate as an experience-duration relation only; it cannot reject another candidate, every experience mention, or the entire advertisement. It is not an automatic training negative.
status_semantics.unknown: Reviewed but unresolved candidate-specific relation; preserve unknown and its insufficiency reason. No relation or negative may be inferred from an empty relations list.
status_semantics.old_labels_and_unknowns: Preserve unchanged. Overlay is separately named and does not replace Batch069, Formal800, old coarse outputs or their unknowns.

probe_required_before_attachment: Verify actual remote existence, byte SHA256 and JSONL row schema of ledger, candidate map, original candidates, context states, contexts and advertisement frame; public code establishes expected structures but no local private rows were inspected.

Check whether the original complete normalized context string and old coarse advertisement text use identical coordinates. If not, retain review offsets only against the pinned recovered complete_context and do not project them to ad-local offsets without an exact verified map.
Check any duplicated ad rows, context collisions, missing joins, and candidate membership conservation without inferring an advertisement-wide negative or changing old outputs.

Verify the accepted KS bridge currently exists with receipt SHA733875..., exactly 10000 unique four-part original ad keys, valid nonnull canonical key values, and exact normalized_context_sha256 values. The old coarse production path and ad coordinate system remain a separate interface check; attachment does not require projecting candidate offsets into that text.
integration_limit: A candidate-level additive reference overlay for the frozen reviewed subset only; no whole-corpus or out-of-frame generalization, no new field certification, and no relabeling of old production.
